title: Wizard
note: Mislabeled at the source: this is EA's platform game Wizard, not Wizard of Wor. The disk holds none of Wizard of Wor's files (no WIZ.5800-9FFF / WIZ.C000-CFFF / WIZ.E000-FFFF); it boots WIZARD 100%/ATG, which pulls in SPRW and M.L. alongside GAME / BLDR / L00T-L19T — the Wizard level set.

title: Wizard
note: Mislabeled at the source: EA's platform game Wizard, not Wizard of Wor. No WIZ.* files on the disk; the first file loads GAME / BLDR / PPSS / SCOR with levels L00T-L39T. PPSS = Progressive Peripherals & Software, who wrote Wizard.

Two games on one disk. LOAD"*",8,1 boots Wizard of Wor (the loader prints WIZARD - BROKEN BY THE BANDIT and pulls in WIZ.5800-9FFF / WIZ.C000-CFFF / WIZ.E000-FFFF / SCOR), but GAME / BLDR / L00T-L37T on the same disk are EA's Wizard. Titled correctly; expect the other game if anything loads a file by name.
Two games on one disk, same as the Bandit release: LOAD"*",8,1 boots Wizard of Wor (WIZ.* + SCOR), while GAME / BLDR / L00T-L37T are EA's Wizard.

Two games on one disk, and the boot order is the surprise: LOAD"*",8,1 starts WIZARD -> WIZ.5800-9FFF etc, which is Wizard of WOR. EA's Wizard itself is GAME / BLDR / L00T-L53T, loaded by name. Filed under Wizard because that is what the release is, but do not expect it to start.
